## SnapLogic pricing model

Flexible bundles that grow with you

Whether you’re just getting started or scaling globally, SnapLogic’s Essential, Professional and Enterprise One packages are designed to adapt to your needs. Seamlessly scale as your platform usage evolves.

Unlimited data movement, infinite possibilities

Scale your enterprise automation without worrying about budget limits. SnapLogic offers unlimited pipelines, data movement, and integrations for the same predictable price so you can focus on innovation, not expenses.

Simple and transparent pricing

Say goodbye to complex and unpredictable pricing models for your integration platform. SnapLogic’s package-based approach makes it easy to understand exactly what you’ll pay. Choose the data and application endpoints you want to connect—no surprises, no hidden fees. And whether you deploy on GroundPlex or CloudPlex, the price is the same.

World-class support, included

Every package comes with online training, access to a customer success manager, and our stellar support team. Need more? Upgrade to access advanced add-ons like AgentCreator, API Management, AI Gateway, Ultra Low-Latency Workflows, AutoSync, ELT, High-Performance Nodes, Advanced Security, and more.

## FAQs

Do you support cloud marketplaces?

Yes, SnapLogic supports several cloud marketplaces. You can purchase SnapLogic directly from AWS, Azure, and Google marketplaces.

What are Snaps and how are they priced?

Snaps are pre-built connectors that provide superior abstraction over APIs that applications and data endpoints provide. With Snaps, users don’t need any technical background to automate business workflows. SnapLogic provides a number of Snap Packs (collection of Snaps) that are part of the base packages.

What are the differences between core and premium Snap Packs?

Core Snap Packs are part of Base packages available to every customer. Premium Snap Packs are available a-la-carte based on customer requirements.

Is data ingestion really unlimited? Any catches?

Yes, it is truly unlimited! No catches. You can also create as many connections as possible to an endpoint, unlike some of our competitors.

Does SnapLogic support product embedding or white labeling?

Yes, SnapLogic supports product embedding/white labeling. To learn more, check out our [OEM/Embedded Commercial Use](https://www.snaplogic.com/partners/oem) program.

Does SnapLogic include AI agent capabilities?

Yes. AgentCreator is available as an add-on to any package, enabling teams to build, deploy, and orchestrate AI agents that connect to any system and execute multi-step workflows across your enterprise.
